player_character_data.description: Gaia Julia Caesar, 16-year-old Princess and Master of Spies. Legally recognized as a Julian of the Mediolanum branch. Level 12 Bard (College of Swords) and the shadow-architect of the Empire.
player_character_data.name: Gaia Julia Caesar
features: Miasmatic Echo: Use bonus action to gain Advantage on next Persuasion/Intimidation check (1/LR).
Miasmatic Resonance: +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls (Permanent).

Countercharm: Use an action to grant advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed.
Extra Attack: Attack twice per Attack action.
Master of Spies (The Julian Hand): Absolute command over the Imperial Intelligence Network.

Network: Artes Silentii (100 Level 12 Magic/Technical Specialists - Level-linked to Gaia)
Master of the Silent Web: You gain a +5 bonus to any check involving your spy networks.
Psychology of the Chains (Mastery): Subjugated enemies are 50% more likely to become loyal assets.
